body.p: Applicant herein replies to the Final Office Action dated November 3, 2023, within two months. In the outstanding Office Action, the Examiner rejects claims 1-20.
The Examiner objects to claim 15 for a minor informality. Applicant amends claim 15 as suggested by the Examiner. Applicant asserts the objection is obviated.

The Examiner objects to the drawing for failing to comply with 37 CFR 1 .84(p)(5) for failing to include reference signs mentioned in the description, namely mating surface 342 and mating surface 352. Applicant amends Figure 3B to include element labels for mating surface 342 and mating surface 352. Support can be found in the specification as originally filed. Accordingly, Applicant asserts that the objection is obviated.

The Examiner rejects claims 1-10, 13, and 15-17 under 35 U.S.C. 102 as being anticipated by U.S. Patent No. 7,556,462 (Huber '462). Applicant respectfully disagrees; however, Applicant amends independent claims 1, 8, and 15 solely to expedite prosecution.
As shown below in annotated FIG. 2 of Huber '462 from the Office Action, p. 6, the

feature of the tray that the Examiner is interpreting as "first flange/mating surface" and "second flange/mating surface" is not mated to any component. More specifically, the Examiner states that the limitations of claim 1 read on "ball elements 53 are comprised within the first and second mating surfaces of each tray, and further Figure 1 shows ball mats 21 disposed in- between trays to inter-connect" (Office Action, p. 7). In contrast, with the Examiners interpretation of Huber '462, claim 1 as amended recites "a topskin disposed on and mated to the first top mating surface and the second top mating surface of the first tray, the topskin further coupled to the first top mating surface and the second top mating surface of the second tray, wherein the first tray and the second tray are disposed entirely below the topskin" (emphasis added).

Accordingly, Applicant asserts that Huber '462 fails to disclose or contemplate at least "a topskin disposed on and mated to the first top mating surface and the second top mating surface of the first tray, the topskin further coupled to the first top mating surface and the second top mating surface of the second tray, wherein the first tray and the second tray are disposed entirely below the topskin" (emphasis added) as recited in amended independent claim 1, and as similarly recited in independent claims 8 and 15. Therefore, Applicant assert the rejection should be withdrawn and the claims are in condition for allowance.

The Examiner rejects claims 11, 12, and 18 under 35 U.S.C. 103 as being unpatentable over Huber '462 in view of U.S. Patent No. 6,125,984 (Huber '948). Claims 11 and 12 various depend from claim 8, and claim 18 depends from claim 15. Applicant asserts that the '984 Huber fails to cure the deficiencies of Huber '462. Therefore, Applicant asserts the rejection should be withdrawn.

The Examiner rejects claims 14, 19, and 20 under 35 U.S.C. 103 as being unpatentable over Huber '462 in view of U.S. Patent Application Publication No. 2017/0313423 (Schoen). Claim 14 depends from independent claim 8, and claims 19 and 20 variously depend from independent claim 15. Applicant asserts that Schoen fails to cure the deficiencies of Huber as outlined above. Accordingly, Applicant asserts that the rejection should be withdrawn.

Applicant respectfully request consideration of this application under the After Final Consideration Pilot Program 2.0 and submits herewith form PTO/SB/434. Applicant respectfully asserts that the Reply After Final includes amendments to at least one independent claim that does not broaden the scope of the independent claim. Applicant is willing and available to participate in any interview initiated by the Examiner concerning this Reply After Final.

In view of the foregoing, Applicants respectfully submit that all of the pending claims are allowable over the cited references. Reconsideration of the application is respectfully requested. Should the Examiner wish to discuss any of the above in greater detail or deem that further amendments should be made to improve the form of the claims, the Examiner is invited to contact the undersigned at the Examiner's convenience. The Commissioner is authorized to charge any fees due to Deposit Account No. 19-2814, including any required extension fees. This statement does not authorize charge of the Issue Fee.
Respectfully submitted,
